context.style: cinematic luxury, dark surfaces, expressive type, acid yellow

constraints.existingBrandDescription: Existing black and acid-yellow Lamborghini editorial concept

profile.name: Editorial publication
profile.reason: Selected because this profile applies to editorial and audience “luxury automotive enthusiasts” with the requested cinematic luxury, dark surfaces, expressive type, acid yellow style; profile matching uses explicit type, audience-keyword, and style-keyword overlap.

direction.visualPrinciple: Let the story and its structure lead, with interface chrome kept secondary.
direction.typography: Preserve the existing brand typography and improve hierarchy through its established type roles.
direction.color: Preserve the existing brand palette; improve accessible pairings and supporting cues without replacing its colors.
direction.layout: Constrain article width and preserve clear headings, captions, and related-content groups.
direction.interaction: Keep reading controls and subscription actions discoverable without interrupting comprehension.

recommendations.title: Preserve brand decisions as an explicit constraint
guidance: When brand preservation is requested, reuse approved assets and tokens and limit changes to layout, clarity, and accessible pairings.
If a necessary improvement would change a brand decision, explain the trade-off and request approval before replacing it.

recommendations.title: Define a compact, semantic type scale
guidance: Define named text roles for display, headings, body, labels, and supporting text rather than styling each element independently.
Use fluid sizing only within intentional minimum and maximum bounds, and preserve readable body text on narrow screens.

recommendations.title: Optimize line length for sustained reading
guidance: Constrain paragraph width to a comfortable measure and allow headings to use a separate, wider measure when appropriate.
Check line wrapping at narrow and wide viewport sizes instead of relying on a single desktop screenshot.

recommendations.title: Constrain page content independently from the viewport
guidance: Set a page or section maximum width and center it while keeping backgrounds free to span the viewport.
Use narrower measures for reading and forms, and wider measures only for data-heavy or multi-column tasks.

recommendations.title: Show users where they are in the product
guidance: Mark the active route in navigation using more than color alone and expose the current page semantically.
For deep content structures, use breadcrumbs only when they clarify a meaningful hierarchy and each parent is actionable.

recommendations.title: Use semantic structure and meaningful headings
guidance: Use native elements for headings, navigation, buttons, lists, and main content instead of styling generic containers to imitate them.
Keep heading levels ordered by document structure, not by the font size a visual design requires.

recommendations.title: Support zoom, reflow, and text resizing
guidance: Avoid fixed-height text containers and test content at 200% zoom and narrow viewport widths.
Let text wrap without clipping controls, labels, or essential instructions.

recommendations.title: Reuse the project’s established design tokens
guidance: Inspect the project’s current color, typography, spacing, radius, and elevation tokens before adding styles.
Extend the existing token model with the smallest justified addition instead of introducing a competing palette.

recommendations.title: Build components around stable semantic roles
guidance: Define component variants around meaningful roles such as primary action, warning, or compact density.
Keep page-specific composition outside the shared component unless repeated use demonstrates a stable pattern.

recommendations.title: Make keyboard focus visible and predictable
guidance: Provide a visible focus indicator with sufficient distinction from surrounding states and avoid removing browser focus without a replacement.
Keep tab order aligned with reading order and ensure overlays manage entry, dismissal, and focus return.

recommendations.title: Preserve brand colors while fixing accessible pairings
guidance: When preserving a brand, first adjust foreground/background combinations, font weight, borders, and supporting labels.
Do not replace approved brand colors without permission; document any unavoidable contrast trade-off and affected component.

recommendations.title: Verify text contrast for every semantic color role
guidance: Check foreground and background pairs against the relevant WCAG contrast criteria at actual rendered sizes.
Test semantic states and themes separately; do not assume a color is accessible because its hue differs from the background.

recommendations.title: Separate semantic colors from decorative accents
guidance: Create separate tokens for brand emphasis, neutral surfaces, borders, and semantic feedback states.
Avoid reusing the same color for unrelated actions and alerts unless their meaning remains clear through labels and context.
